decision.reason: All twelve retained small native solves pass dense/oracle gates, work/admission checks and memcheck. The 230-AO supplied-Hamiltonian CCSD solve additionally converges from MP2 and passes independent energy/full-amplitude gates. Native molecular DF CCSD(T) source/triples/forces remain unqualified.

reproduction.instructions: Apply gzip -dc source.patch.gz | git apply to the exact parent. Set PYTHONPATH=python:., CUDA12.9.86 on PATH and checkout-root CCACHE_BASEDIR; use ccache for the separate objects. Run CUDA tests only with GENERATIVEQC_DF_CC_CUDA_TEST=1 inside finite Slurm main gpu:5090:1 allocation, preserving CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. qualification.json.gz contains exact record-generation source and complete test logs; point its final host/GPU binary paths to the pytest outputs. sanitizer.json.gz includes complete unfiltered logs and base64-encoded binary stdin. The probe input header is seven uint64 values followed by FP64 arrays as documented in tests; no reference library is imported by a native solver. Molecular exact-pair factorizations are solver oracles, not DF fitting accuracy claims. Apply qualification.patch.gz after source.patch.gz for the later large-case reproducer and documentation; measured native code is unchanged. Recreate the pinned independent ethane230 state with df_ccsdt_large_oracle.py. Use OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 with df_ccsd_native_solver_probe.py --state <state.npz> --reference <reference.json> --input <input.bin> --summary <input.json>; pipe that binary input to the native solver probe under finite Slurm main gpu:pro6000:1 on n2, then invoke the adapter with --result <stdout.txt> to check all amplitudes and physical residuals. large-ethane230.json.gz retains input/output/amplitude hashes, exact timings/work and source roundoff policy; it excludes source preparation, (T), and forces.
